scope: Bounded carrier strategy investigation and full qualification of a smaller opt-in fixed-outline candidate; no hardware circuit edits, gate waivers, retry-ceiling increases or routing work
finding: Compact packing stops at its first geometrically successful order, before automatic sizing checks connectivity cost. qualification.implementation: Current core at base_commit; isolated C++ BoardPipelineOptions runner, native_policy=true, timing=true, no_render=false, pcb.compact_search=true, pcb.experiment.interior_order=3, pcb.floorplan_spec points to unchanged project spec except fixed outline {w:168,h:160}
qualification.side_utilisation_note: Counts are not occupied-face area. The smaller result has fewer bottom instances than the reference (131 versus 176); bottom utilisation remains an improvement opportunity, not a claimed gain
qualification.thermal_note: Model-based gate with emitted-copper evidence, not measured thermal qualification; hottest reported device 134.8 C at the configured ambient/load
qualification.visual_inspection: Inspected actual 3d_top.png and 3d_bottom.png: complete board, expected edge connectors/mounting holes/SoM footprint; bottom remains sparse. Visual inspection is not proof of unmodelled assembly clearance or fabrication readiness
unresolved: PCA9306 power-transition behaviour and other previously recorded hardware uncertainties remain open

timing_seconds.note: One sequential full run, no simultaneous tests or compilation. No clean compile timing measured in this batch. This is not a matched Python comparison; retained historical comparison limitations still apply

repeatability.scope: Two additional fresh model solves from the newly qualified schematic; parsed inputs reused, no zone or placed-model cache
repeatability.comparison: diff of every receipt and fallback_count line for run 1 versus run 2; exit 0
